tools.description: Search Tipline's sourced notes about Grand Theft Auto VI (characters, places, vehicles, weapons, activities, systems, release info; missions, cheats and collectibles as they are confirmed after launch). Returns short entries, each with its page URL and original sources. Only sourced facts; if nothing matches, the guide doesn't know yet.

limit.description: How many entries to return (1 to 10)

query.description: What to look for, in English, e.g. 'Ultimate Edition cars' or 'who is Cal'

tools.name: search_gta6_guide
tools.title: Search the GTA 6 guide

tools.description: Get the full text (markdown) of one Tipline entry by id, with its sources.

id.description: Entry id from search or list results, e.g. 'lucia-caminos'

tools.name: get_gta6_entry
tools.title: Get one guide entry

tools.description: List Tipline entries (id, title, summary, url), optionally filtered by type.
tools.name: list_gta6_entries
tools.title: List guide entries

tools.description: When Grand Theft Auto VI unlocks in each country (UTC and local time), the rules behind it, and sources.

country.description: Optional country name or ISO code to filter, e.g. 'Brazil' or 'AE'

tools.name: gta6_release_times
tools.title: GTA 6 release time by country

tools.description: Confirmed Grand Theft Auto VI story-mode cheat codes: name, how to unlock it, and the D-pad sequence (PS5 and Xbox Series X|S), with the source entry. Only codes confirmed by several outlets are listed; there are no online cheats.

query.description: Optional filter by cheat name, e.g. 'ammo' or 'health'

tools.name: get_gta6_cheats
tools.title: GTA 6 cheat codes

location.description: Optional filter by place, e.g. 'Little Cuba' or 'Vice City'
